lines.en: label tsuneyospring1:
scene tsuneyoyumitalk1
There is a place in the heart of the old district that-
lines.zh: 在老城区的心脏地带，有这样一个地方——

lines.en: Well, I guess it’s not so much the heart as it is the liver.
lines.zh: 嗯，我想它与其说是心脏，不如说是肝脏。

lines.en: So there’s this place in the liver of the-
lines.zh: 那就是在……的肝脏里有这么个地方——

lines.en: No, that doesn’t work either.
lines.zh: 不，这么说也不对。

lines.en: Hold on.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: Okay, got it.
lines.zh: 好，有了。

lines.en: So there’s this place in the old district where special things happen.
lines.zh: 在老城区有这样一个地方，那里会发生特别的事。

lines.en: It does not run parallel to the heart, liver, or any other internal organs. But it does serve as a shortcut between what’s real and what most can only dream of.
lines.zh: 它并不与心脏、肝脏或任何别的内脏平行。但它确实是连接“真实”与“大多数人只能在梦中见到之物”的一条捷径。

lines.en: Complicated, I know. But the laymen have died and no one knows what’s become of their terms. So it now falls on me to explain the way this works and I’m just not very good at that yet.
lines.zh: 我知道，很复杂。但那些行家都死透了，没人知道他们的术语变成了什么。于是解释这件事如何运作的重任就落到了我身上，而我在这方面还不太在行。

lines.en: I’ve been kept within these walls for far too long, you see. And my narrative muscles are not yet strong enough to grip the brush I need to paint you a better picture.
lines.zh: 你看，我被困在这些墙里太久了。我的叙事肌肉还不够强壮，握不住那支为你画出更好图景所需的画笔。

lines.en: So instead, I will rely on anecdotal word vomit and hope you can put things together yourself.
lines.zh: 所以，我只能依靠一堆轶事般的胡言乱语，希望你能自己把事情拼凑起来。

lines.en: Just please be sure to not make a mess of anything.
lines.zh: 只是请务必别把什么弄得一团糟。

lines.en: This is a restaurant after all.
lines.zh: 毕竟这是一家餐厅。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk2
Yumugucho Yamo show up eat noodle gonna have a fun time.
lines.zh: Yumugucho Yamo 出现吃面将会玩得开心。

lines.en: Been walk long so foot pain. Gotta make the bread so water nice to nipples.
lines.zh: 走了很久所以脚疼。必须做面包让水对乳头很好。

lines.en: Girl tooth Pedro Martinez and the chicken backdrop create non-financial interest in location the big boy don’t like too much.
lines.zh: Girl tooth Pedro Martinez 和鸡的背景板在大男孩不太喜欢的地方制造出非金钱的利益。

lines.en: But that’s okay because the child memory is a jacket. Makes the cold warm so the stars don’t hurt her eyes when light sphere under covers.
lines.zh: 但没关系，因为童年的记忆是一件外套。让寒冷变得温暖，这样被窝下的光球就不会刺痛她的眼睛。

lines.en: Found a penny, picked it up. Then she stuck in a cup. Now her arms are red and head is dead and pills don’t fix corrupt.
lines.zh: 捡到一分钱，把它捡起来。然后她把它塞进杯子里。现在她的手臂是红的，脑袋死了，药丸修不好腐败。

lines.en: Now to the noodles — the glorious noodles.
lines.zh: 现在来说面条——光荣的面条。

lines.en: So victorious, laborious, the chorus of noodles. Near a pile of Styrofoam arms and a doodle.
lines.zh: 如此胜利，如此艰辛，面条的合唱。在一堆泡沫塑料手臂和一幅涂鸦旁边。

lines.en: But head pasta don’t understand the average of Sunday no S.
lines.zh: 但头部的面食不懂没有 S 的星期天的平均值。

lines.en: Not know what up above.
lines.zh: 不知道上面有什么。

lines.en: Not know the wires, can’t find the gloves. So press on button to make the meat come but the meat is a cylinder no longer have fun.
lines.zh: 不知道那些电线，找不到手套。于是按下按钮让肉出来，可肉是个圆柱体，不再有趣了。

lines.en: Just want to feel like there is a reason for the fluid in the flesh wound.
lines.zh: 只是想让血肉伤口里的液体有一个存在的理由。

lines.en: And sometimes it feels like you won’t ever understand.
lines.zh: 而有时候，感觉你永远都不会懂。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk1
Wait.
lines.zh: 等等。

lines.en: Let me start over again.
lines.zh: 让我重新开始。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk2
Yumi Yamaguchi shows up to eat ramen.
lines.zh: Yumi Yamaguchi 来吃拉面。

lines.en: That’s all you need to know.
lines.zh: 你需要知道的就这些。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk3
: Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know if you have any questions.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo Ramen。请慢慢看菜单，有任何问题都可以告诉我。

lines.en: : Nobody else is here tonight?
lines.zh: : 今晚没有别人吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk4
: If there could be a “worst” season for ramen, it would be Spring.
lines.zh: : 如果拉面也有“最差”的季节，那一定是春天。

lines.en: : The temperature is not hot, nor is it cold. And the seasonal ingredients are lighter in nature. Both literally and figuratively.
lines.zh: : 气温不热，也不冷。应季的食材也比较清淡。无论字面上还是比喻上都是如此。

lines.en: : But there is nothing to worry about. I will still make you something that can take you back in time.
lines.zh: : 不过不用担心。我依然会为你做出能把你带回过去的东西。

lines.en: : Uhh...I ain’t lookin’ to go back in time. Just kinda hungry and shit. What’s the cheapest thing you got?
lines.zh: : 呃……我又不是想回到过去。就是有点饿什么的。你这儿最便宜的是什么？

lines.en: : You may help yourself to a pair of chopsticks for the road. On the house.
lines.zh: : 您可以免费取用一双筷子带在路上。本店请客。

lines.en: : Fuckin’ food, you weirdo. I ain’t poor enough to be eating chopsticks just yet.
lines.zh: : 操，是吃的啊，你这个怪人。我还没穷到要吃筷子的地步。

lines.en: : I would be willing to sell you a single piece of edamame for 10 yen.
lines.zh: : 我愿意以 10 日元的价格卖给您一颗毛豆。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk5
: This another one of your fuckin’ stand-up comedy bits or whatever? Heard about those. Kinda hoped I’d be able to avoid ‘em as a paying customer, though.
lines.zh: : 这又是你他妈的什么脱口秀段子之类的？我听说过那些。不过作为付费顾客，我还挺希望能躲过去的。

lines.en: : I apologize for what you have perceived as poor service. I am simply attempting to provide an intimate and customized experience for the daughter of our most treasured customer.
lines.zh: : 很抱歉让您觉得服务不周。我只是想为我们最珍视的顾客的女儿，提供一种贴心而定制的体验。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk6
: Hah...yeah. Yuki won’t shut the fuck up about this place, so I figured I’d come give it another shot. Been a while since I last came anyway.
lines.zh: : 哈……是啊。Yuki 他妈的把这儿吹得不行，所以我想着再来试一次。反正我也好久没来了。

lines.en: : It certainly has.
lines.zh: : 确实很久了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk4
: Please take a seat wherever you’d like.
lines.zh: : 请随意入座。

lines.en: : As you have noted yourself, there is no one else here tonight. Which gives you complete control over the conversations we will have and what you will get out of them.
lines.zh: : 正如您自己所说，今晚这里没有别人。这让您可以完全掌控我们将要进行的对话，以及您想从中得到什么。

lines.en: : As well as your soup, bro.
lines.zh: : 还有您的汤，兄弟。

lines.en: : How ‘bout I just eat the soup and we don’t talk at all? Shit’s already weird as fuck and I haven’t even sat down yet.
lines.zh: : 不如我就光喝汤，咱俩一句话都别说？妈的怪得要死，我还没坐下呢。

lines.en: : This is a special place, Yamo.
lines.zh: : 这是个特别的地方，Yamo。

lines.en: : Yumi.
lines.zh: : Yumi。

lines.en: : You may claim to desire a silent meal, but your heart will argue otherwise. And any feelings that it contains can be left on the counter so you’ll be free to leave lighter and less worried.
lines.zh: : 你嘴上说着想要安静地吃一顿，可你的心不会同意。它装着的所有情绪都可以留在吧台上，这样你离开时就能轻松一些，少些烦恼。

lines.en: : Yeah. Whatever. Just give me the fuckin’...chashumen. And a bottle of water.
lines.zh: : 行。随便。给我来他妈的……叉烧面。再来一瓶水。

lines.en: : How much garlic would you like?
lines.zh: : 您想要多少蒜？

lines.en: : Yes.
scene black
: I understand. Please give me one moment while I prepare your dish for you. Please help yourself to any of our many amenities while I do so.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。请稍等片刻，我这就为您准备。期间请随意使用我们的各种设施。

lines.en: : What fuckin’ amenities does a seedy ass ramen shop even have?
lines.zh: : 一家破破烂烂的拉面店能有什么他妈的设施？

lines.en: : Some of our customers seem to enjoy drawing pictures with crayons. Perhaps you, too, would-
lines.zh: : 我们的一些客人喜欢用蜡笔画画。也许您也——

lines.en: : Just make my god damn soup, ramen girl!
lines.zh: : 给我他妈的做汤就行了，拉面女！

lines.en: : As you wish, Yamo.
lines.zh: : 如您所愿，Yamo。

lines.en: : Yumi!
lines.zh: : Yumi！

lines.en: : Apologies, but my name is Tsuneyo Tojo- not Yumi.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我的名字是 Tsuneyo Tojo——不是 Yumi。

lines.en: : God, why the fuck does Yuki even come here?
lines.zh: : 天啊，Yuki 到底为什么老来这儿？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk7
The ramen girl arrives with ramen in tow just several minutes later.
lines.zh: 几分钟后，拉面女孩端着拉面来了。

lines.en: It was the one thing she was good at and the one thing she prided herself on doing on a consistent basis.
lines.zh: 这是她唯一擅长的事，也是她唯一引以为傲、始终坚持在做的事。

lines.en: Which didn’t mean there weren’t other things she enjoyed.
lines.zh: 但这不代表她没有别的喜好。

lines.en: She liked birds. She liked watching them. She’d been staying up late memorizing their calls on an app she found while exploring her smartphone.
lines.zh: 她喜欢鸟。喜欢观察它们。她最近一直熬夜，用她在探索智能手机时发现的一个 app 记鸟的叫声。

lines.en: She liked that too. She didn’t have one until the time came for her to leave the nest. And she was shocked to see just how much world there was outside of Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: 她也喜欢那部手机。直到该离巢的时候，她才拥有第一部。她震惊地发现，Tojo Ramen 之外竟然有这么大的世界。

lines.en: She was still getting used to most of it, as evidenced by her inability to communicate in the ways that people wanted or expected her to.
lines.zh: 她还在适应其中的大部分，这一点从她无法以人们想要或期待的方式交流就能看出来。

lines.en: But she didn’t care much about that as she’d learned when she was younger to never bend or she would break.
lines.zh: 但她不太在意这个，因为她小时候就学会了——永远不要弯腰，否则就会折断。

lines.en: Tsuneyo Tojo had a responsibility, to say the least. And even though she was now free, she always returned to the nest as she didn’t want it being trampled on or stolen by cuckoos.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo Tojo 至少有一份责任在身。尽管她如今自由了，她总会回到巢里，因为她不想它被践踏，或被布谷鸟偷走。

lines.en: But even if those foreign calls might come from predators, she never stopped being entranced by them. And she’d listen closely as their cries carried throughout the second half of town.
lines.zh: 但即便那些异乡的叫声可能来自捕食者，她依旧为它们着迷。她会仔细聆听，听它们的啼鸣在小镇的另一半回荡。

lines.en: : Caw.
Occasionally, she would try and mimic those cries.
lines.zh: 偶尔，她会试着模仿那些叫声。

lines.en: : ...What?
: I apologize. What I meant to say was, “please let me know if there is anything else you need.”
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我想说的是，“如果您还需要什么，请告诉我。”

lines.en: : Did you just make a fucking bird noise?
lines.zh: : 你刚才是不是学了一声他妈的鸟叫？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk8
: That must have been the wind.
lines.zh: : 那一定是风声。

lines.en: : The fuck is wrong with you?
lines.zh: : 你他妈有什么毛病？

lines.en: The problem with avian mimicry is the disappointment it brings once those fake calls are found.
lines.zh: 模仿鸟叫的问题在于，一旦那些假叫声被识破，随之而来的就是失望。

lines.en: Most creatures don’t liked being copied, you know. Because, with a food chain so large and violent, no one ever knows who wants to eat whom and they all wind up fearing one another.
lines.zh: 要知道，大多数生物都不喜欢被模仿。因为在这条如此庞大而暴烈的食物链里，谁也不知道谁想吃掉谁，于是它们全都开始互相惧怕。

lines.en: But that fear can still be quashed with the raising of one’s wings or the showing of one’s belly.
lines.zh: 但只要张开翅膀，或是露出肚皮，那份恐惧依然能被压下去。

lines.en: So the ramen girl would lift her shirt up so the yakuza princess would feel more at home.
lines.zh: 于是拉面女孩会撩起衬衫，好让黑道公主更自在一些。

lines.en: : I’m not quite sure. Perhaps there is a gas leak in the building?
lines.zh: : 我不太确定。也许是楼里有煤气泄漏？

lines.en: Just not really because that would go against health code.
lines.zh: 其实并不是，因为那违反卫生条例。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk9
: Come to think of it, it does smell kind of weird in here.
lines.zh: : 说起来，这里闻起来确实有点怪。

lines.en: : This building has been around for a very long time and has various issues regarding ventilation. Perhaps a free piece of edamame would provide you the incentive needed to ignore it?
lines.zh: : 这栋楼年头很久了，通风方面也有各种问题。也许一颗免费的毛豆能给您足够的动力去忽略它？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk10
: Yeah, I’m good. Might change my mind if you want to throw a whole bowl in, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不用了。不过你要是想送我一整碗，我倒是可以考虑。

lines.en: : You are asking for more than I am both willing and capable of giving. But the option of spilling your heart all over the counter-top still exists.
lines.zh: : 您要的东西超出了我愿意、也有能力给出的范围。但把心事全倒在吧台上这个选项依然存在。

lines.en: : Again, no. The fuck do you want to talk to me for anyway? We haven’t even communicated since that fuckin’ weird...beach contest thing.
lines.zh: : 再说一遍，不用。你他妈到底想跟我说什么啊？自从那次……怪得要死的海滩比赛之后，我们根本就没说过话。

lines.en: : Are you referring to when I defeated you and singlehandedly mutilated any sense of pride that you may have had?
lines.zh: : 您是指我击败您、并凭一己之力把您可能残存的任何自尊都碾碎的那一次吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk11
: Hey! You only won because that weird goth teacher conspired against me! Shit wasn’t fair.
lines.zh: : 喂！你赢是因为那个变态哥特老师串通起来搞我！那根本不公平。

lines.en: : What is even less fair is the fact that baby finches have their brains consumed by their mothers shortly after hatching. Considering that morbid fact, you got off relatively easy. Didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 更不公平的是，雏鸟在孵化后不久，脑子就会被母亲吃掉。考虑到这个残酷的事实，你已经算是走得挺轻松了。不是吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk12
: Uhh...
: What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk13
: What I am saying is that you should be happy your brains were not eaten by your parents. For such a thing would have prevented you from competing in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，你该庆幸自己的脑子没被父母吃掉。因为那样的话，你一开始就没法参赛了。

lines.en: : I mean...they did plenty of other terrible shit to me. Eating my brains might have been savin’ me years of...anger and shit like that.
lines.zh: : 嗯……他们对我干的混账事本来就够多了。把我的脑子吃掉说不定还能省下我好多年的……愤怒之类的。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk14
: I see. So it is parenting you would like to discuss.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。那么，你想聊的是父母这个话题。

lines.en: : What? No? I-
lines.zh: : 什么？不是吧，我——

lines.en: : Please, there is no need to compliment me on my ability to see through you. For I, too, am a parent. And I can sense when there is a daughter in need.
lines.zh: : 请不必夸奖我看穿你的能力。因为我自己也是为人父母。我能察觉到，什么时候有一个女儿需要帮助。

lines.en: : Come to me, my child. Explain what it is that troubles you so that I may respond with cryptic, vague advice for you to interpret in a way that will improve your life.
lines.zh: : 到我这儿来吧，我的孩子。说说是什么在困扰你，好让我用晦涩而含糊的建议回应你，让你用自己的方式去解读，从而改善你的人生。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk15
: How about I just eat and you just shut up?
lines.zh: : 不如我就吃我的，你他妈闭嘴？

lines.en: : You could have gone anywhere to eat. But you came here. And I can sense that silence will do you no favors of any form.
lines.zh: : 你本可以去任何地方吃饭。可你来了这儿。我能感觉到，沉默对你不会有任何好处。

lines.en: : You are worried about something. And despite our history as enemies and the fact that I have proven that I am stronger than you, I do not want you to be intimidated by me.
lines.zh: : 你在担心什么事。尽管我们曾是敌人，尽管我已经证明过我比你强，但我不想让你对我感到畏惧。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk16
: I ain’t fuckin’ intimidated by shit. I’ve just got no fuckin’ clue how to talk to you or any of the other girls in our class since you’re all fuckin’ lunatics.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不怕呢。我只是他妈的不知道该怎么跟你、跟我们班上其他任何一个女生说话，因为你们全都是他妈的疯子。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk17
: Guess you earn a few points for being one of the few who doesn’t want to fuck the teacher, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，你算是少数几个不想睡老师的，这点倒是给你加了几分。

lines.en: : He has fucked me many times.
lines.zh: : 他上过我很多次。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk18
: What?! You too?! Are you fuckin’ kidding me?!
lines.zh: : 什么？！你也？！你他妈在逗我吧？！

lines.en: : Why, he has even fucked me from the very stool you’re sitting in.
lines.zh: : 是啊，他甚至就在你坐着的那张凳子上上过我。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk19
: Is the one next to me any safer?
lines.zh: : 那我旁边这张会安全点吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk14
: I’m afraid it is not. And I urge you to both fuck and be fucked as well for it does wonders for one’s self-esteem and overall attitude.
lines.zh: : 恐怕不会。而且我建议您也去上别人、也被别人上，因为这对一个人的自尊和整体心态有奇效。

lines.en: : Yeah, aight. You want to talk about parents? Let’s go back to that. I’ll take that over this any day of the week.
lines.zh: : 行，好。你想聊父母？那我们回到那个话题。一周七天我都宁愿聊那个。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk13
: An excellent choice. Now, speak.
lines.zh: : 明智的选择。那么，说吧。

lines.en: : What, like...like, just do it? You ain’t gonna ask me any, like...questions or some shit? I’m supposed to just tell one of my classmates I ain’t even friends with about my parents?
lines.zh: : 什么，就这样……就这样说？你不打算问点……问题之类的？我就该跟一个连朋友都算不上的同学讲我爸妈的事？

lines.en: : Right now, I am not your classmate at all.
lines.zh: : 此刻，我根本不是你的同学。

lines.en: : I am the ramen girl — your personal bank for emotions and concern. And all that you spill will be cleaned and left on rags that I throw into a large, grey bucket at the end of the night.
lines.zh: : 我是拉面女孩——你存放情绪与烦恼的私人银行。你倒出来的一切都会被清理干净，留在抹布上，到了夜里我就把抹布扔进一只灰色的大桶里。

lines.en: : You mean you, like...ain’t gonna remember any of it?
lines.zh: : 你是说，你……不会记得这些？

lines.en: : That is correct.
lines.zh: : 没错。

lines.en: : Your new life began when you walked through that door, and it will end the moment you exit. And there is nothing to gain from sharing the secrets of the dead.
lines.zh: : 你的新生活从你走进那扇门开始，到你走出去的那一刻结束。而分享死者的秘密，毫无益处。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk20
: You know I ain’t gonna trust you just cause you go and say weird shit like that, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我不会因为你说了这些怪话就信你吧？

lines.en: : Other people might be cool with openin’ up in places like this, but I’m perfectly fine just never sharin’ anything with anyone.
lines.zh: : 别人也许很乐意在这样的地方敞开心扉，但我完全可以永远什么都不跟任何人说。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk21
: Specially when some people are just gonna fuckin’ laugh at me for trying.
lines.zh: : 尤其是有些人只会他妈的笑话我。

lines.en: : So the issue is that you do not trust me. I see.
lines.zh: : 那么问题在于你不信任我。我明白了。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk14
: I understand. And I apologize if it may have sounded like my intention was to force your hand.
lines.zh: : 我理解。如果我听起来像是要逼你开口，那我向你道歉。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk13
: Most of the customers at Tojo Ramen do not hold back their thoughts when conversing with me, so I am not used to dealing with those who would rather keep things confidential.
lines.zh: : Tojo Ramen 的大多数客人在和我交谈时都毫不保留，所以我不太习惯应对那些宁愿保密的人。

lines.en: : You ain’t gotta apologize, but it’s like...ain’t you the same way?
lines.zh: : 你不用道歉，不过话说……你不也一样吗？

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？

lines.en: : I mean...if you, like...
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果你，那个……

lines.en: : Let’s put it in fuckin’ fighting terms. That shit’s easier for me to understand or whatever.
lines.zh: : 咱们用打架的说法来讲吧。那样我比较好懂之类的。

lines.en: : As a samurai, I’m inclined to agree.
lines.zh: : 作为一名武士，我倾向于同意。

lines.en: : Yeah, cool. Then, as a samurai, wouldn’t it make you worry to just straight up expose your weaknesses to people? You’re easier to kill if you let your guard down.
lines.zh: : 行，酷。那么，作为一名武士，把自己的弱点直接暴露给别人，你不会担心吗？你放下戒备就更容易被杀。

lines.en: : A samurai must still shower.
lines.zh: : 武士也总得洗澡。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk14
: There are times in which the armor must come off. Does communing with an innkeeper mean that you are revealing your weakness to them as well?
lines.zh: : 总有些时候，盔甲必须脱下来。和一位旅店老板打交道，难道也算向他们暴露了弱点吗？

lines.en: : You ain’t a fuckin’ innkeeper. You make noodles.
lines.zh: : 你才不是什么他妈的旅店老板。你就是做面的。

lines.en: : And I make them well. But I am also the only person who will listen to many of those who walk through my doors.
lines.zh: : 而我做得很好。但我也是唯一一个愿意倾听走进我这扇门的许多人的人。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk13
: And I was simply under the impression that you may want to be one of those people.
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，你也许想成为那些人中的一个。

lines.en: : Well...
: Nah...Nah, it’s still weird.
lines.zh: : 不……不，还是太怪了。

lines.en: : Like, maybe if I didn’t already know you it might change shit. But I do. And I ain’t about to go spillin’ any of my backstory when I don’t know shit about yours. Learned my lesson when it comes to that.
lines.zh: : 就是说，要是我根本不认识你，也许会不一样。可我认识你。在你对我的过去了如指掌之前，我是不会把我自己的事倒出来的。这种事我早就学乖了。

lines.en: : My backstory is rather simple.
lines.zh: : 我的过去相当简单。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk22
: This building is my home. I was raised by the owner, my father, who is now confined to bed upstairs.
lines.zh: : 这栋楼就是我的家。我由老板——我的父亲——抚养长大，如今他卧病在楼上的床上。

lines.en: : He taught me how to swing a sword and strangle game-fowl. And I pay him back by carrying on his legacy and his wishes.
lines.zh: : 他教我如何挥剑，如何掐死家禽。而我靠延续他的遗志与心愿来报答他。

lines.en: : And one day, when the wires work no more, I hope to be half the person he was.
lines.zh: : 等到有一天，那些电线不再工作的时候，我希望自己能有他一半那么好。

lines.en: : Wires?
lines.zh: : 电线？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk23
: The ones that keep him going.
lines.zh: : 那些让他继续活下去的电线。

lines.en: : He is all but a machine now.
lines.zh: : 他现在几乎就是一台机器。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk24
: Oh, shit...I didn’t realize it was that bad.
lines.zh: : 哦，操……我不知道已经这么严重了。

lines.en: : Glad he was at least, like...present for a while, though. Couldn’t be my old man.
lines.zh: : 不过至少……他曾经在你身边待过一阵子，这点是好事。我那个老头子可做不到。

lines.en: : That’s all I’m gonna say, though. But you should be thankful you got even that outta me.
lines.zh: : 不过我只能说这些了。你能从我这儿套出这些，就该知足了。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’ll tell me more if you decide to return.
lines.zh: : 也许你决定再来的话，会告诉我更多。

lines.en: : But in the event that you don’t, I have a question for you.
lines.zh: : 但如果你不来了，我有一个问题要问你。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk25
: Another weird, personal one? Or, like...a normal fuckin’ question this time?
lines.zh: : 又一个奇怪的私人问题？还是这次……是个正常的他妈的问题？

lines.en: : Normal enough. There’s just something I would like to know.
lines.zh: : 足够正常。只是有件事我想知道。

lines.en: : Then...shoot, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那……问吧。

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk13
: Does the date December 28th, 2020 mean anything to you?
lines.zh: : 2020 年 12 月 28 日这个日子，对你有什么意义吗？

lines.en: scene tsuneyoyumitalk26
scene black

Bam. Zoom. Event complete.
lines.zh: 砰。唰。事件结束。
